nodes.label: project.mcap Directory Format
nodes.rationale: A project is a directory, not a single archive, so a crashed session can be recovered file by file and large arrays stay as npz next to their json metadata.

nodes.label: Backend Plugin System
nodes.rationale: Detectors and reconstructors are plugins behind stable interfaces, discovered via entry points. Swapping the AI must not require touching the rest of the app; unavailable backends stay listed with a human-readable reason.

nodes.label: Optional MediaPipe Install
nodes.rationale: The AI dependency is an extra, not a core dependency, so the app runs and its tests pass without it; the detector panel simply reports the backend as unavailable.

nodes.label: Bone Name Auto-Mapping
nodes.rationale: An ordered rule table matched against separator-stripped names, most specific first, so LeftForeArm reaches the forearm rule before the bare arm rule. Conservative by design: an unmatched role is left empty rather than filled with a plausible-looking bone.

nodes.label: Explicit Coordinate Conversion
nodes.rationale: No module may convert coordinates silently. Conversions are named functions at named boundaries, so a wrong axis is a visible call site rather than a hidden sign flip.

nodes.label: Schema Versioning
nodes.rationale: Every file carries schema_version and a reader refuses a newer one rather than guessing at fields it does not understand.

nodes.label: Profile Scan Precedence
nodes.rationale: Bundled, then user directory, then the project copy, later winning. A project carries the profile it uses so it still retargets on a machine whose user directory is empty.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking UI
nodes.rationale: Video analysis must never run on the Qt main thread. Long work goes through a Qt-free TaskManager whose callbacks fire on the worker thread; the UI marshals them back with Qt signals.

nodes.label: Deferred 3D Reconstruction
nodes.rationale: 3D is architecture-ready but 2D-first: real reconstruction arrives late as an interchangeable backend rather than shaping the whole MVP.

nodes.label: Rig-Independent Skeleton Representation
nodes.rationale: AI keypoints must not depend on Blender bone names. An intermediate canonical skeleton sits between them so multiple detectors and multiple rigs are both supported.

nodes.label: Rig Name Independence
nodes.rationale: No code path references a specific rig's bone names. Supporting a new rig is a data task (drop in a profile), which is what makes custom rigs possible at all.

nodes.label: Embedded Bone Map
nodes.rationale: Carrying the canonical-to-rig bone map inside the clip lets the Blender add-on place rotations without knowing anything about the app's rig registry.

nodes.label: Incremental Development Workflow
nodes.rationale: One feature at a time: analyse, explain the plan, implement, test, summarise. No unrequested features and no placeholder implementations.

nodes.label: Modular Architecture Rule
nodes.rationale: Logic must never collect in one file; UI, video, pose, skeleton, retargeting, export and Blender integration are separate modules.

nodes.label: UI / AI Logic Separation
nodes.rationale: Keeping UI logic out of the AI and animation code is what lets the domain be tested headlessly and the UI be replaced.

nodes.label: Lightweight Hexagonal Architecture
nodes.rationale: UI -> orchestration -> domain -> adapters. The domain stays pure Python and Qt-free so it is unit-testable without a UI; technical concerns (Qt, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Blender) live only at the edges.

nodes.label: Four-Level Data Pipeline
nodes.rationale: L0 detector-native -> L1 canonical joints -> L2 canonical bone rotations -> L3 rig-named curves. Each level is owned by one layer so a new AI backend only touches L0->L1 and a new rig only touches L2->L3.

nodes.label: Blender Code Isolation
nodes.rationale: Blender-specific code must never mix into the core application, so the app runs and tests without bpy installed.

nodes.label: Y-up Interchange, Z-up at the Boundary
nodes.norm_label: y-up interchange, z-up at the boundary
nodes.rationale: The file is always canonical Y-up; the consumer converts. blender_addon/conversion.py is a deliberately separate implementation from app/math/coordinates.py.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Correction Layer
nodes.rationale: Manual fixes live in a sparse overlay, never overwriting detection. The effective pose is detection combined with corrections on demand, so re-running the detector never destroys the user's edits.

nodes.label: Partial Bone Map Is Valid
nodes.rationale: Real rigs have no left_hip/right_hip bone, so an incomplete mapping is normal rather than an error; unmapped bones are reported instead of failing the retarget.
